mapper.sql: p.project_id, p.customer_id, c.customer_alias AS customer_name, p.project_alias, p.project_type, p.risk_level, p.status, p.delete_flag, p.created_at, p.created_by, p.updated_at, p.updated_by, p.deleted_at, p.deleted_by

choose.when: p.delete_flag = FALSE AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
(p.delete_flag = TRUE OR p.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR p.status = 'DELETED')

where.if: AND ( LOWER(p.project_alias) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(c.customer_alias) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT FROM tbl_dim_project p INNER JOIN tbl_dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT FROM tbl_dim_project p INNER JOIN tbl_dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.project_alias ASC OFFSET #{offset} LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_dim_project p INNER JOIN tbl_dim_customer c ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM tbl_dim_customer WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' )

SELECT team_id FROM tbl_dim_team WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND team_id IN
#{teamId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_dim_project ( project_id, customer_id, project_alias, project_type, risk_level, status, delete_flag, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by, deleted_at, deleted_by ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{customerId}, #{projectAlias}, #{projectType}, #{riskLevel}::severity_level, #{status}::record_status, #{deleteFlag}, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy}, #{deletedAt}, #{deletedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_dim_project SET customer_id = #{customerId}, project_alias = #{projectAlias}, project_type = #{projectType}, risk_level = #{riskLevel}::severity_level, status = #{status}::record_status, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND delete_flag = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'

WITH disabled_project_team AS ( UPDATE tbl_project_team SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE' RETURNING project_team_id ), target_repositories AS ( SELECT repository_id FROM tbl_dim_repository WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ), updated_repositories AS ( UPDATE tbl_dim_repository SET delete_flag = TRUE, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, status = 'DELETED', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE repository_id IN (SELECT repository_id FROM target_repositories) AND status <> 'DELETED' RETURNING repository_id ) UPDATE tbl_dim_project SET status = 'DELETED', delete_flag = TRUE, deleted_at = #{deletedAt}, deleted_by = #{deletedBy}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND delete_flag = FALSE AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT pt.project_team_id, pt.project_id, pt.team_id, t.team_code, t.team_name, pt.status, pt.created_at, pt.created_by, pt.updated_at, pt.updated_by, pt.deleted_at, pt.deleted_by FROM tbl_project_team pt INNER JOIN tbl_dim_team t ON t.team_id = pt.team_id WHERE pt.project_id = #{projectId} AND pt.deleted_at IS NULL AND pt.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY t.team_name ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_project_team ( project_team_id, project_id, team_id, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{projectTeamId}, #{projectId}, #{teamId}, #{status}::record_status, #{createdAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt}, #{updatedBy} )
